known_consumers.why_reachable: The shared input dispatcher recognizes both frozen Radiance magic tokens and invokes the I9 wrapper before its generic HDR and RAW routing.

separate_owners.why_not_a_consumer: The shared legacy image record retains an RGBE loader identity and a separate Bayer-filter acronym, but does not include or call the I9 wrapper.
The shared image helper classifies .hdr and DT_IMAGE_HDR state without including or calling the I9 wrapper.
FILTERS_ARE_RGBE is a CFA-layout acronym and dt_imageio_open_hdr is a distinct stale declaration; neither references an I9 linkage symbol.
The view displays an RGBE loader label but does not include or call the I9 wrapper.
The host data list advertises .hdr independently of the wrapper and must be reconciled with the dispatcher and packaging owners.
